purpose: Supporting visual references for generating consistent static Scarlet portraits from angles not covered by the approved front images.

authority_policy.generated_views: The owner approved this supporting 360-degree pack on 2026-07-22. These views explain hidden geometry, but never override the approved face, front hair topology, body proportions, or front costume details.

orientation.side_names: Scarlet's anatomical side, not the viewer's side

views.role: Front full-body proportions, costume, hands, legs, and footwear
Right facial volume and front-to-right costume continuity
Right face silhouette, cyan lock depth, posture, and side costume
Right-side transition into natural rear hair and costume
Natural rear silhouette, hair length, color distribution, and visible lower costume
Left-side transition into natural rear hair and costume
Left face silhouette, magenta hair depth, posture, and side costume
Left facial volume and front-to-left costume continuity

supporting_details.role: Hidden rear collar, shoulder, spine, waist, and hip panel reference; not a natural hairstyle pose
Left/right palms, hand backs, manicure, cuff geometry, and sleeve termination

known_limits: Approved supporting views can contain small rendering drift and remain subordinate to the two canonical front authorities.
The approved portrait remains the only authority for close facial identity and makeup.
The approved T-pose remains the authority for front body proportions and costume placement.
Views use a neutral studio background for comparison and are not application-ready portrait assets.
